Hi {{name}}, here's what you'll be able to do after {{course}}: {{outcome}} ✅

en:
Hi {{name}} 👋 Thank you for visiting Infonic Training today!

Save this number 📲 Ask anything about courses, fees or batch timings right here on WhatsApp — we reply in minutes.

Hi {{name}} 👋 You asked about {{course}} on Instagram/Facebook. Quick version: {{outcome}}.

en: Hi {{name}}, in {{course}} you don't just watch — you build. You'll finish with real projects and a portfolio you can show employers or clients. See our students' work: {{proof_link}}

name: ad_whyus
en:
Why students choose Infonic 👇
✅ Small batches · ✅ Hindi + simple English
✅ Classroom or online live with recordings
✅ Internship option + placement assistance
✅ 3,000+ students since 2012 · ★ 4.9/5

Try a free demo before paying anything.

Students Infonic kyun chunte hain 👇
✅ Chhote batch · ✅ Hindi + simple English
✅ Classroom ya online live, recordings ke saath
✅ Internship option + placement assistance
✅ 2012 se 3,000+ students · ★ 4.9/5

hi: Hi {{name}}, is baare mein ye humara aakhri message hai 🙏 Aage ke batches ki info bhejte rahein, ya enquiry band kar dein?

call_nudge

en:
Totally understand, {{name}} — fees are a big decision 🙏 Ways to make it easier:
• No-cost EMI on fees above ₹15,000
• Online live classes cost less (with recordings)
• Save up to 20% with on-the-spot, group or seasonal offers (T&C)
• Fast-track options with a smaller fee
hi:
Bilkul samajh sakte hain, {{name}} — fees bada decision hai 🙏 Ise aasan banane ke tarike:
• ₹15,000 se upar no-cost EMI
• Online live classes sasti (recordings ke saath)
• On-the-spot, group ya seasonal offer mein 20% tak bachat (T&C)

name: certificate_ready
en: Great news, {{name}}! 🎓 Your {{course}} {{document_type}} is ready. {{collect_or_download}}
hi: Khushkhabri, {{name}}! 🎓 Aapka {{course}} {{document_type}} ready hai. {{collect_or_download}}

name: job_alert
en: 💼 New opening for {{course}} students: {{role}} at {{company}} ({{location}}). Interested? Reply "Apply" and our placement team will guide you.
hi: 💼 {{course}} students ke liye nayi opening: {{role}}, {{company}} ({{location}}). Interest hai? "Apply" likho, placement team guide karegi.

name: interview_reminder
en: All the best for tomorrow's interview at {{company}}, {{name}}! 🍀 Quick tips: {{tips}}. Want a 15-minute mock interview today?
hi: Kal {{company}} ke interview ke liye all the best, {{name}}! 🍀 Chhote tips: {{tips}}. Aaj 15 minute ka mock interview karein?

name: interview_followup
en: Hi {{name}}, how did the {{company}} interview go? Tell us — we'll help with the next step either way.
hi: Hi {{name}}, {{company}} ka interview kaisa raha? Batao — kaisa bhi raha ho, agle step mein help karenge.

name: event_confirm
en: You're registered for {{event}} on {{event_date}} at {{event_time}} ✅ We'll send the link before it starts.
hi: Aap {{event}} ke liye registered ho, {{event_date}} ko {{event_time}} baje ✅ Shuru hone se pehle link bhejenge.

name: event_link
en: {{event}} starts in 1 hour! Join here: {{event_link}}
hi: {{event}} 1 ghante mein shuru! Yahan join karo: {{event_link}}

name: event_followup
en: Thanks for joining {{event}}, {{name}}! Here's the recording: {{recording_link}}. Want to go deeper? Our {{course}} course starts {{batch_date}} — attendees get a special offer (T&C apply).
hi: {{event}} join karne ke liye thank you, {{name}}! Recording yahan hai: {{recording_link}}. Aur gehraai mein seekhna hai? Humara {{course}} course {{batch_date}} se shuru — attendees ke liye special offer (T&C apply).

name: demo_booked
en: Hi {{name}}, your free demo class for {{course}} is booked for {{demo_time}} at Infonic Training, Ajmer Road, Jaipur. We're looking forward to meeting you! Reply here if you need to change the time.
hi: Hi {{name}}, aapki {{course}} ki free demo class {{demo_time}} ko Infonic Training, Ajmer Road, Jaipur mein book hai. Aapse milne ka intezaar rahega! Time badalna ho to yahin reply karein.
notes: Chatbot Playbook section 10. When: Right after the counsellor books a demo. Uses positional variables as in the PDF: {{1}}=name, {{2}}=course, {{3}}=demo date/time.

name: followup_1day
en: Hi {{name}}, still thinking about {{course}}? 😊 Most students ask about fees, online classes and the internship before joining — tap below and we'll answer in a couple of minutes.
hi: Hi {{name}}, {{course}} ke baare mein soch rahe ho? 😊 Join karne se pehle zyadatar students fees, online class aur internship poochte hain — neeche tap karo, 2 minute mein jawab denge.
notes: Chatbot Playbook section 10. When: No reply for 1 day, no booking. Uses positional variables as in the PDF: {{1}}=name, {{2}}=course. Button text "T alk to counsellor" in the PDF extraction fixed to "Talk to counsellor". Stray space before ?/: after {{2}} in the PDF removed.

name: followup_4day
en: Hi {{name}}, a new {{course}} batch starts on {{batch_date}} — weekday and weekend timings, classroom or online live. Would you like to see a free demo class first?
hi: Hi {{name}}, {{course}} ka naya batch {{batch_date}} se shuru ho raha hai — weekday aur weekend timing, classroom ya online live. Pehle ek free demo class dekhna chahoge?
notes: Chatbot Playbook section 10. When: Still no reply after 4 days (send once, then stop). Uses positional variables as in the PDF: {{1}}=name, {{2}}=course, {{3}}=batch date.

name: after_demo
en: Hi {{name}}, thank you for attending the {{course}} demo today! 🙌 How did you find it? If you have any questions about the course, fees or timings, just reply here.
hi: Hi {{name}}, aaj {{course}} ki demo class attend karne ke liye thank you! 🙌 Kaisi lagi? Course, fees ya timing ke baare mein koi sawaal ho to yahin reply karein.
notes: Chatbot Playbook section 10. When: Same day, after the demo. Uses positional variables as in the PDF: {{1}}=name, {{2}}=course.

name: package_offer
en: Hi {{name}}, since you were looking at {{course}}: most students who want a job take the full {{package_course}} course — it includes {{course}} and costs less than taking courses one by one. Want the details?
hi: Hi {{name}}, aap {{course}} dekh rahe the: job chahne wale zyadatar students poora {{package_course}} course lete hain — usme {{course}} bhi hai aur alag-alag course lene se sasta padta hai. Details bhejun?
notes: Chatbot Playbook section 10. When: Asked about a single short course and didn't book. Uses positional variables as in the PDF: {{1}}=name, {{2}}=short course looked at, {{3}}=full course/package. Stray space before ?/: after {{2}} in the PDF removed.

name: otp_login
en: {{1}} is your Infonic Training verification code. For your security, do not share this code.
notes: Used for: Student portal / app login. Note: Expires in 10 minutes. Authentication template — Meta fixes the wording; {{1}} = the code.

name: otp_demo
en: {{1}} is your verification code to confirm your free demo booking. For your security, do not share this code.
notes: Used for: Confirm a demo booking made on the website. Note: Stops fake bookings. Authentication template — Meta fixes the wording; {{1}} = the code.

name: otp_referral
en: {{1}} is your verification code. For your security, do not share this code.
notes: Used for: Verify a friend's referral claim. Note: Stops referral abuse. Authentication template — Meta fixes the wording; {{1}} = the code.

name: otp_payment
en: {{1}} is your verification code. For your security, do not share this code.
notes: Used for: Confirm a fee payment or EMI change request. Note: Use before changing a fee plan or bank details. Authentication template — Meta fixes the wording; {{1}} = the code.
